Built-in installation (preview)
Install with MM Auto only. No Shizuku or King Installer app is needed. This preview uses Android wireless debugging on this phone.

1. Connect your phone to Wi-Fi and enable Developer options → Wireless debugging.\n2. Open MM Auto and Settings side by side using split screen.\n3. In Settings, choose Pair device with pairing code. Keep that window open and enter its six-digit code below. Leave the port empty to find it automatically.
